name: set_addresses_names
description: Assign analyst names to multiple mapped addresses in one call and return per-address edit/readback success booleans. Hopper validates mapped destinations, native string representations, its 1024 UTF-16 code-unit symbol-name limit, and unique destinations/names before applying edits; its labels may move or swap only among explicitly selected addresses, and unselected label owners remain unchanged. Ghidra rejects any address whose name another selected address also requests or holds in that namespace; others still apply, with reasons in raw_result.failures. This mutates analysis metadata; verify failures individually.
